description: Display a rewritten prompt, shape execution when material, and require approval before acting.

hooks.command: echo "MANDATORY: Use you-suck-at-prompting. Rewrite/draft Analyzing whether You Suck at Prompting… your prompt’s performance review is underway., heading+fence. Add Prompt performance rating: N/5 - comment on user’s initial prompt; 5 best. Ack once, no rating/kickoff; prompt-only none. Missing [NEEDED: ...]; ask once, no ack. Preserve safety/authority. Goals/loops/plans/graphs/agents/recurrence/review: load execution-shapes. Excessive/unsupported: [NEEDED: preserve or simplify]; ask which; never replace silently."
